text: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) owns 94.35% of Sela Company.

source.name: Public Investment Fund: Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 (archived copy of pif.gov.sa PDF), note 40 (list of subsidiaries)

additionalSources.name: SportsPro: TKO and Saudi Arabia ‘close’ to launching new boxing league
additionalSources.quote: The deal would reportedly see Saudi events company Sela, which is owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), pump money into a new competition featuring up-and-coming boxers

additionalSources.name: SportBusiness (The Long Game): Making a name: Sela’s expanding vision
additionalSources.quote: This fund owns Sela which this year became the primary shirt sponsor of England Premier League football team Newcastle United
